paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在附录中提及[23]以引用Nyquist定理，仅作为技术背景说明，并未涉及目标论文的RFID亚毫米级感知或穿墙窃听能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: the resulting audio sampling rate is 8 kHz, implying that, according to the Nyquist theorem [23], frequency components up to 4 kHz can be captured.
evidences.evidence_context: In our configuration, the resulting audio sampling rate is 8 kHz, implying that, according to the Nyquist theorem [23], frequency components up to 4 kHz can be captured. This range is sufficient for most speech recognition applications.
evidences.reference_entry: HJ Landau. Sampling, data transmission, and the nyquist rate. Proceedings of the IEEE, 55(10):1701–1706, 1967.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用标记[23]对应的是Landau 1967年的论文，仅用于说明Nyquist定理，与目标论文（Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration）无关，属于误引。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 该引用正文中的[23]并非目标论文，而是Landau 1967关于Nyquist定理的经典文献，属于false_positive。
